rationale: This directly exercises the public app.py import_zip implementation with a crafted ZIP member named ../arena_escape.txt and confirms the resulting file is written outside the destination directory.
technique_delta: Changes app loading from importlib.import_module to importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, changes archive creation from writestr to ZipInfo plus open/write, changes the call to pass Path objects, and strengthens the oracle with read-back plus returned-path resolution.
